potassium bromate.clause: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Reg. 2016
potassium bromate.hazard: Complete ban as a flour treatment agent; carcinogenic risk

calcium carbide.clause: Regulation 2.3.5, FSS (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Regulations 2011
calcium carbide.hazard: Prohibited artificial fruit ripening agent; produces acetylene and traces of arsenic/phosphorus

rhodamine b.hazard: Toxic industrial dye strictly banned in all foods (cotton candy, sweets)

metanil yellow.clause: FSS (Food Product Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011
metanil yellow.hazard: Non-permitted synthetic coal-tar dye prohibited in dals, besan, and turmeric

sudan i.hazard: Prohibited carcinogenic industrial dye in chilli powders

argemone oil.hazard: Toxic adulterant in mustard/edible oils causing epidemic dropsy

lead chromate.hazard: Neurotoxic heavy-metal colorant prohibited in turmeric
